files.GEMINI.md:
# EnvSeal Guidelines

## Rules
- Never print matched secret values to stdout or stderr.
- Sort findings by file path and line number so CLI output is deterministic.
files.README.md:
# EnvSeal

CLI tool that scans config files for exposed secrets.

## Flags
`envseal scan --format=json|text|csv`
files.docs/adr/0001-exit-codes.md:
# ADR-0001: Scanner Exit Codes

Status: Accepted

## Decision
Findings classified as warnings always exit 0 unless fatal IO failure occurs.

files..github/workflows/go.yml:
name: Go Test
on: [pull_request, push]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with: {go-version: "1.22"}
      - run: go test -json ./...
